title: Matched random break-even control for the trend and pullback harnesses: a break-even trigger action (stop to entry from the bar after the trigger bar, default off, byte-identical), 100 seeded matched-rate random trigger draws per arming level run as declared control arms, and the leave-one-fold-out best-of-grid report; unblocks RQ-20261029-1f39-01 under RULE-AM-RISK-ADJUSTED-V1
note: Filed by lane AM-RISK-ADJUSTED-RULE 2026-10-29. MEASURED: scripts/backtest_trend.py and scripts/backtest_pullback.py have the peak-armed break-even lever (--be-floor-r, MI-165) but --trigger-action accepts only bank/tight, and no producer draws a matched-rate random trigger set from an arm's armed count (path_metric_giveback.shuffle_triggers needs a trigger model run). RULE-AM-RISK-ADJUSTED-V1 R4 needs that control, so the break-even unit RQ-20261029-1f39-01 (research/queue/blocked/) cannot be read without it. Done when: both harnesses take a 'be' trigger action with tests (default byte-identical), the matched draws (count = the X arm's armed trades, seeded random bar while open, 100 draws per X) run as control arms through am_risk_adjusted run-legs, best_static LOFO is reported, and the unit is moved to research/queue/ with the control arms added to run.command. Tier 1 research tooling (harness flag default off).
